buyList.title: Buy List
buyList.intro: Cards the collection's owner wants to buy. They're flagged when they turn up in a scan or an intake, and customers can see them on the kiosk.
buyList.introAdmin: Cards the collection's owner wants to buy. They're flagged when they turn up in a scan or an intake, and customers can see them on the kiosk. Each game has its own list.
buyList.empty: Nothing on this Buy List yet.

setAside.label: Set-aside location
setAside.none: None: keep them with the rest
setAside.help: Wanted copies of this game go here when they're added from a scan or bought in an intake, instead of the location they would normally go to.
setAside.pickGame: Choose a game in the top bar to set where its wanted copies go.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.noteHelp: Shown in scans and intakes. Customers never see it.

delete.title: Remove {{name}}?
delete.body: It comes off the Buy List and stops being flagged.

scan.banner_one: {{count}} Buy List card in this scan. Don't pass it up.
scan.banner_other: {{count}} Buy List cards in this scan. Don't pass them up.
scan.detailTitle_one: On the Buy List: {{count}} copy wanted
scan.detailTitle_other: On the Buy List: {{count}} copies wanted
scan.setAside: Wanted copies go to {{location}} when added.
scan.setAsideIntake: Wanted copies go to {{location}} when bought.
scan.committed_one: {{count}} copy counted off the Buy List.
scan.committed_other: {{count}} copies counted off the Buy List.
scan.notSetAside_one: {{count}} copy stayed here: you can't add cards to the set-aside location.
scan.notSetAside_other: {{count}} copies stayed here: you can't add cards to the set-aside location.

intake.banner_one: {{count}} Buy List card on this quote. Don't pass it up.
intake.banner_other: {{count}} Buy List cards on this quote. Don't pass them up.
intake.noCopiesLeft: All wanted copies are taken by other lines
intake.partial: Buy List rate on {{copies}} of {{total}} copies

settings.title: Buy List rate
settings.help: What to pay for copies still wanted on the Buy List. Leave blank to pay the regular percentage. Condition still applies, and wanted cards are never treated as bulk.
settings.customerHint: Sellers can see a higher per-card offer if the customer view shows card offers.
